summary: Master retail loss prevention and fraud analytics with practical tools, scorecards, and control design. Reduce shrink and improve reporting.
lede: Retail shrink analysis helps store and operations professionals identify loss patterns and improve controls using sales, stock, and incident data. The course covers calculating shrink, reconciling inventory, reviewing POS exceptions, mapping CCTV and RFID controls, triaging suspected fraud, and reporting findings through dashboards and action plans.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for retail professionals who manage shrink, fraud, stock integrity, and store control performance across single-site or multi-site operations.
prerequisites: You will need a laptop with spreadsheet software and the ability to work with sample retail data files. Prior experience in store operations, inventory control, audit, security, or fraud investigation is recommended so you can complete the applied exercises with realistic examples.
